'''Impetuous Impulses''' is a [[minigame]] based around the [[Hunter]] skill where players capture [[implings]], which are flying [[imp]]-like creatures, that can be caught to obtain trinkets and treasures that they have been stealing from all over [[Gielinor]]. This activity takes place in an area called [[Puro-Puro]].
